content.title:
Mock scores going
*up and down?*
content.subtitle: That is normal. Here is what to look at instead of the number.

qa.a: Different mocks test different topics. One low score usually means one weak topic, not a weak child.

qa.q: What should I ask after a mock?
qa.a: Ask which questions went wrong and what they will practise this week. The plan matters more than the score.
If the same mistakes repeat week after week. That is the time to change the plan, not to add pressure.
qa.note: A good review after each mock is worth more than an extra mock.
